questions.question: What overcurrent threshold must the pack's protection use? Thresholds for about 49.7 A, against 3.0 V a cell (F9) and 0 to 55 °C (owner, 2026-09-30), at or below the pack's 90 A continuous. Round 1 set them for 12.23 A (V150).
questions.why: IOBoard.md:397 states only that R7 set the thresholds for 12.23 A (V150) and that the about 49.7 A of the Pack path current row needs a follow-up of R7; neither page states the trip current itself, only the floor (about 49.7 A, itself nominal with no stated upper bound) and the ceiling (90 A, the cell's continuous rating). V150's Answer (Research.md:846) covers over-temperature, under-temperature, per-cell overvoltage and short-circuit, not the overcurrent trip point. Without a number, or an instruction that the exact value is for research, P2 cannot set or verify the MAX17320G22+'s, or any candidate's, overcurrent trip point for the FU-2B1 follow-up.
